lines.1: I wondered where Yashi, who clearly didn't socialize enough, might be.
lines.2: Looking out for a first-year made me a good senior. Maybe Otome's athletic-club spirit was rubbing off on me.
lines.3: Huh... Yashi wasn't on the roof.
lines.4: Maybe I should try Ryugu--the student council room.
lines.7: 「Hurry up and cry... Heh heh heh.」
lines.10: Yashi coolly looked down at her and laughed.
lines.11: Those two were cheerfully fighting again today.
lines.15: 「Ha! Girls like you really do exist--spoiled rotten by your parents without learning a thing about how the world works.」
lines.18: 「Ellie, the eye doctor is still open, you know.」
lines.19: 「Hmph. There's nothing wrong with my eyes. They're only playing around.」
lines.20: 「Really...? They look like they genuinely hate each other.」
lines.21: 「Well, it isn't that catty, passive-aggressive kind of fighting, so it's fun to watch.」
lines.22: You were here? Talk about no presence.
lines.23: 「Let's settle this in black and white--zebra stripes and all! I challenge you, Coconut!」
lines.26: 「Your constant yapping has become irritating. I want to crush you completely, just once.」
lines.28: 「Specifically, I want to crush you so completely you'll be too ashamed to come back to school.」
lines.29: She meant to drive her senior into refusing to attend school.
lines.30: 「And how are you actually going to compete?」
lines.31: 「Hmm. It wouldn't be fair if I chose. Hey, one of you decide for us.」
lines.33: 「Right. Let's hear from the peanut gallery as though nothing happened.」
lines.34: 「I-I think combat sports would be dangerous. There'll be blood.」
lines.36: 「Crab's such an idiot she'd lose to me at Go with a twenty-stone handicap, so spare her that.」
lines.37: 「Hmm. Then I propose table tennis. How about it?」
lines.39: 「...Heh heh. Just like a Coconut: hardheaded outside, but your brains are mushy milk porridge. Table tennis happens to be my specialty!」
lines.40: 「Heh heh heh... I'll crush that confidence along with you.」
lines.41: Whoa. She was radiating pure villainy.
lines.42: She certainly had the delinquent spirit for it.
lines.46: But the conversation moves faster without you.
lines.55: 「Well, changing might be better. I don't want her blaming clothes that are hard to move in when she loses.」
lines.57: 「--Yeah, this is the place to play table tennis.」
lines.58: 「Table Tennis Club! Sorry, but we're playing a game, so clear one table for us.」
lines.60: 「Yes! I-I got to talk to the Princess!」
lines.73: Crab, ever particular, chose a penhold paddle.
lines.75: 「To lose in front of such a large audience...」
lines.76: 「Same to you, Coconut. I'll have you whining, 'This can't be happening,' like some third-rate loser.」
lines.77: Yashi settled firmly into her stance.
lines.78: 「Neither of them will ever admit defeat. This'll be worth watching in every sense. Seriously.」
lines.88: 「Going big, Princess. Then I'll bet on Crab.」
lines.89: 「As members of the student council executive committee, have none of you considered behaving as examples to the other students?」
lines.91: 「Even you, Ms. Inori?! This is unacceptable.」
lines.92: 「Don't be so rigid. It's a little everyday entertainment. We'll exchange the cash discreetly afterward.」
lines.93: 「No. During a festival would be one thing, but allowing this on an ordinary day is...」
lines.94: Otome was as inflexible as ever.
lines.95: 「Kurogane, living with a little more flexibility would be less exhausting.」
lines.96: 「If anything happens, I will take responsibility.」
lines.97: 「If you are willing to go that far, Ms. Inori...」
lines.98: Athletic types really were weak to orders from above.
lines.99: 「Leo, which one are you betting on?」
